open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings
open_points.text:
A missing, malformed or inconsistent value (a wildcard host or origin, binary
bounds out of order) stops the start.
open_points.question: What typed error, fields and message does load_runtime_settings produce on validation failure, including when the call occurs after startup during a Registry call or binary read?
options: Raise a dedicated runtime-settings validation exception on every failed call, with callers translating it as their contracts require
Raise a generic ValueError or library validation exception
Use different errors for initial loading and post-start reloading
open_points.default_guess: Raise one dedicated RuntimeSettingsError carrying a non-secret reason code and variable name; startup callers abort, while binary_storage translates it to BinaryStorageError and registry_gateway translates it to the applicable RegistryBoundaryError.

witness.initial: The service started with valid binary bounds; afterward BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES is changed to exceed MAX_BINARY_RESPONSE_BYTES.
events: A viewer requests a visible progress photo.
module:binary_storage calls load_runtime_settings for that binary read.
outcomes: load_runtime_settings raises a dedicated configuration exception that binary_storage recognizes and translates to BinaryStorageError, producing the explicit storage-unavailable result.
load_runtime_settings raises an unnamed generic validation exception; binary_storage must guess whether to catch it, so it can escape as a generic internal failure instead.
witness.observer: The viewer and the binary-read error handler see different failure classifications.
